lessons_used: Adding new screens (new_screen) was helpful, winning 6 tests (up to +15.4%), though 2 hurt performance (down to -7.7%) and others showed no clear effect.
Waiting screen info updates (wait_info) were helpful, winning 4 tests (up to +5.7%), though 1 hurt performance (-6.0%) and most showed no clear effect.
Layout changes (layout) and redesigns (redesign) were helpful, winning 2 tests each (up to +8.7% and +9.0%), though several hurt performance or were rolled back, and others showed no clear effect.
Copy updates (copy) were helpful, winning 2 tests (up to +5.7%), while 7 tests showed no clear effect.
Step reordering (reorder), hints, notifications, and new flows produced no winning tests; step reordering hurt performance in 1 test (-3.8%) and no clear effect was seen in the rest.
Predictions underestimated several large wins (e.g., predicting -2.0% vs +8.7% measured, -1.5% vs +9.0% measured) and overestimated changes that hurt performance or had no clear effect.

candidates.title: Pet Cloud Retrieval Status Verification Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated status screen right after sign-in selection that explicitly confirms pre-existing cloud pets are detected and safe prior to entering adoption.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into an account.

new_cloud_retrieval_check.body: Verifying saved companion data and past customization options for your account...

components.text: Your existing companions and unlockables will automatically sync.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a cloud check screen in onboarding with all required steps preserved.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support and sign-in drop-off; new screens generally perform well despite high dev cost.

candidates.title: Centered Interactive Desktop Arrival Redesign for Home Intro
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro view into a centered spotlight view focusing on instant desktop controls and pet summoning.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion drops to 44.9% and multiple support emails mention confusion on how to control or summon the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Use double-click on your companion or press Alt+P anytime to summon, hide, or open pet controls.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of home intro screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Supported by emails and funnel data, but redesigns at finish step have averaged 0.0% lift across 4 tests.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Redesign for Choose Path Companion Overview
candidates.change: Rebuilds the Choose Path screen using a stage layout spotlighting available pet archetypes and adoption options.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Desktop Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Choose whether to customize your unique AI pet or pick a classic desktop companion.

guard.reason: Valid layout update preserving both adopt and make-your-own options.

candidates.score_note: Good problem alignment, but new flows have produced no winning tests in prior experiments.
